answers.question: (1) What is inside the pinned T23 OpenAPI closure for POST /api/v1/image/identify and POST /api/v1/url/compare (GET /api/v1/text/compare for reference), and can an optional `lang` be added to either without re-recording T23?
answers.answer: NO for any declared parameter or model field; the re-record is unavoidable and reddens all ten T23 nodes, not two. Pinned closure (fixture tests/fixtures/s71_u13_flag_off_baseline.json, recorded_at eb86075e..., never re-recorded since commit eb8f9e92): POST /api/v1/image/identify = parameters [region query str default 'bahrain', nocache query bool default false, authorization header anyOf str|null] + requestBody multipart $ref Body_identify_and_compare_api_v1_image_identify_post {images: array, required} + responses 200/422 ($ref HTTPValidationError -> ValidationError); no lang, no selected_category. POST /api/v1/url/compare = parameters [authorization header] + requestBody application/json $ref URLCompareRequest {url1 str, url2 str (required), region str default 'bahrain', selected_category anyOf str maxLength 40|null}; no lang. GET /api/v1/url/compare (also one of the ten) = query url1, url2 (required), region, selected_category (maxLength 40) + authorization; no lang. GET /api/v1/text/compare (reference) already carries lang as query anyOf [str maxLength 8, null] title 'Lang' description 'UI language for generated prose (en|ar)', and TextCompareRequest already has lang anyOf [str maxLength 8, null]. The ten-operation closure = {Body_identify..., HTTPValidationError, QuickCompareRequest, TextCompareRequest, URLCompareRequest, URLExtractRequest, ValidationError}. test_T23_openapi_unchanged (:981-997) asserts (a) the FULL operation JSON (sort_keys) of the parametrized route equals the recording and (b) the $ref closure computed over ALL TEN operations equals the recorded closure; so `lang` on URLCompareRequest fails assertion (b) in every one of the ten parametrized nodes, and a Query `lang` on image/identify or GET url/compare fails (a) for that node. No flag can hide a declared parameter: the schema is built from the signature, and the snapshot runs with every flag deleted (_flags(mp) at :471). Only T23 is affected among the OpenAPI-reading tests: test_u13e_url_detect_guard E13 pins /url/detect only; test_w4_13_measurement_truth test 34 compares OFF-vs-ON surfaces of the same tree (a param present in both states is neutral); test_flush_live_price_key pins DELETE /api/v1/text/cache only. The T17 half of the same fixture (30 flag-OFF records) is unaffected by lang (requests carry none) but T17 also asserts `_meta.recorded_at` startswith BASE_SHA_PREFIX='eb86075e' (:103, :767), so a re-record forces a constant edit in the test module. A pin-NEUTRAL alternative exists for the camera route only: read lang off `request.query_params` (schema-invisible; precedent test_flush_live_price_key.py:538-541), but PLAN R-A10 chose the declared param and the deliberate re-record; the ruling below follows R-A10.

answers.ruling_text: RULING T23-RERECORD (for B8 / W4-14b; binding). (1) The backend half of W4-14b adds `lang: Optional[str] = Query(None, max_length=8, description="UI language for generated prose (en|ar)")` to `identify_and_compare` (app/api/image_routes.py:162-168, declared immediately after `nocache`) and to `compare_urls_get` (app/api/url_routes.py:370-377, after `selected_category`), and `lang: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=8)` to `URLCompareRequest` (app/api/url_routes.py:231-243) -- byte-for-byte the declarations text_routes.py:377/:784 already use, so the three new schema nodes equal the existing `Lang` nodes. (2) This DELIBERATELY re-records tests/fixtures/s71_u13_flag_off_baseline.json: the fixture is regenerated ONCE, at the unit branch HEAD after the three declarations (superseding UR11's 'only at BASE' for this unit), in a detached scratch worktree with no .env and no install, with `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 <pinned venv python> -m tests.test_s71_u13_compare_auth_required --record tests/fixtures/s71_u13_flag_off_baseline.json --recorded-at <full HEAD sha>`; run it twice and require byte-identical output (NORMALISED_FIELDS stays {}). (3) The fixture diff in the PR must touch ONLY: `_meta.recorded_at`; `openapi.operations["POST /api/v1/image/identify"].parameters` (+1 lang entry); `openapi.operations["GET /api/v1/url/compare"].parameters` (+1 lang entry); `openapi.components.schemas.URLCompareRequest.properties.lang` (+1 key). The 30 `flag_off_records` and every other operation/component must be byte-identical to the old fixture (the GREEN agent diffs the two JSON documents key by key and pastes the moved-path list in the PR body). (4) In tests/test_s71_u13_compare_auth_required.py: BASE_SHA_PREFIX (:103) becomes the first 8 hex chars of the HEAD sha passed to --recorded-at; the module docstring (:26-40) and the T17 docstring (:757-760) name the new recording commit and this ruling; nothing else in the module changes. (5) Add `ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT`-adjacent names the two routes now read per call to CLEAN_ENV (:72-83) only if new ones are introduced (ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT is already listed). (6) The PR body states, verbatim: 'T23 fixture re-recorded by ruling T23-RERECORD (S80 R0): three `lang` schema nodes added; 30 flag-OFF records and all other operations byte-identical (diff attached)'. (7) No other OpenAPI pin needs a change (E13 /url/detect, W4-13 test 34, flush-cache DELETE are unaffected). (8) Rejected alternative, recorded for the owner: reading `lang` off `request.query_params` on the camera route is schema-invisible (precedent test_flush_live_price_key.py:538-541) and would leave T23 untouched, but it cannot cover the POST body of /url/compare and contradicts R-A10's explicit parameter; the re-record is the chosen cost.

answers.question: (2) Is metadata.stage_timings_ms present in any pinned camera body, is DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS set in the test environment, and is the plan's B1 proposal (add vision_ms/compare_ms keys only when the dict already exists) pin-safe?
answers.answer: SAFE for every existing pin, with two design conditions. (a) No pinned camera body carries stage_timings_ms: the UR11 fixture's three U6 records are the `action:'error'` body {action, error, success:false, vision_cost} with NO metadata key at all (the stub VISION_RESULT has no products), and the string 'stage_timings_ms' does not occur anywhere in the fixture; test_paid_route_metering.py's camera pins drive a stubbed StructuredComparisonService whose compare_from_text returns metadata {total_cost: 0.01} and assert only action/success/metadata.input_method/products length/ledger calls, never a full-body equality; the W4-13 ledger fixture pins log_search kwargs and labels, not bodies. (b) DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS in the test env: it is NOT stripped by tests/_env_safety.py (CREDENTIALS_UNSET/CREDENTIAL_PLACEHOLDERS list only credentials and endpoints), NOT deleted by the U13 CLEAN_ENV, NOT set in any .github workflow, and conftest.py:16 `load_dotenv(override=True)` would import it from a `.env` found by python-dotenv's walk from tests/ upward -- but no .env exists in sc-s80-base or in any parent directory up to C:/ (existence checked, nothing read), so in this worktree and in CI the variable is unset; CLAUDE.md:337 records it as true in production since Sprint A. The scs memo `_DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS` (structured_comparison_service.py:1066-1075) is process-cached, which is why tests that need it reset it or patch the module global (test_stage_timings.py:20/:108, test_s78_*:77/:86). (c) The proposal is pin-safe because: the dict is only ever created by scs at :4612/:5452 (`result.setdefault('metadata', {})['stage_timings_ms'] = orchestrator_timings`) when the debug memo is true; test_stage_timings.py asserts expected keys as SUBSETS (:85-99, `missing = expected - set(keys)`) so extra keys pass, and asserts absence of the key only when the flag is off (:163-164); test_s75_fanout_identity drops stage_timings_ms/orchestrator_timings_ms before hashing (VOLATILE :66-68); the w412 corpus `_stage_timings_ms` per-product keys are popped at scs:4608/5448 and are not compared. Conditions: (i) 'dict already exists' must mean the `stage_timings_ms` key inside metadata -- image_routes.py:482-495 always creates `metadata` itself, so a check on `metadata` would create the timing dict on every camera body and move the metering pins' `metadata` and any future body pin; (ii) because production has DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS=true, an addition gated only on dict presence changes production camera bytes the moment B1 merges, before ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA flips -- that violates R-A1 (additive keys go behind a flag) even though no pin sees it; gate on BOTH the flag (read per call) AND the key's presence.

answers.ruling_text: RULING B1-TIMINGS (binding for B1). (1) The camera route may add `vision_ms`, `vision_moderation_ms` and `compare_ms` ONLY into an existing `result['metadata']['stage_timings_ms']` dict (key presence, not `metadata` presence -- image_routes.py:482-495 creates `metadata` itself), and ONLY when `ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA` is truthy on that call; it never creates the `stage_timings_ms` key and never reads DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS or `scs._DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS`. Reason: production runs DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS=true (CLAUDE.md:337), so a presence-only rule would change production camera bytes at merge, before the flip (R-A1). (2) Pin status: the proposal moves no existing pin -- the UR11 camera bodies carry no metadata, the metering camera pins use a stubbed service and assert named keys, test_stage_timings asserts key subsets, test_s75_fanout_identity drops the dict before hashing. (3) B1's own rows, each setting or deleting BOTH `ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA` and `DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS` (never relying on the ambient env): RED-1 flag ON, stubbed service returning `metadata.stage_timings_ms = {'total_ms': 1.0}` -> the three keys present and numeric >= 0; PIN-1 flag OFF, same stub -> the dict equals the stub's dict byte-for-byte; PIN-2 flag ON, stub WITHOUT the key -> `'stage_timings_ms' not in body['metadata']`; PIN-3 flag OFF/ON with the UR11-shaped error exit (no products) -> body has no `metadata` key. (4) The same telemetry values go to the Sentry info line regardless of the dict (the line is the measurement; the dict is a debugging convenience). (5) The text and URL paths add no timing keys in B1 (the dict is produced and finalised inside scs:4612/5452 and the URL path never builds it). (6) Harness: DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS is unset in CI and in sc-s80-base (no .env on the dotenv path); a developer .env that sets it WOULD flow into every pytest process through conftest.py:16, so the GREEN agent's comm set runs once with `DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS=true` exported and once unset, and both must be green.

answers.question: (3a) For B3 (VISION-IDENTITY-V2): which fixtures pin the vision prompt (identify_products) and must be regenerated under the flag-ON branch, and how does the flag-OFF branch stay byte-identical?
answers.answer: The vision prompt has NO digest pin today. The W4-11 fixture tests/fixtures/w4_11_prompt_render_digests.json (26 keys) renders only extract_specs_targeted/synthesized from openai_service (recorder :145/:151) plus url_extract_* and image_tier3_*; `identify_products` is never rendered. No test pins a literal phrase of the prompt (grep for 'product identification expert', 'WITHOUT packaging', 'OCR skills', 'READ the EXACT text' in tests/: zero hits). The kwargs of identify_products are not in test_model_config_enforced's SHIPPED table (12 sites; identify_products absent), but the M1 AST pin forbids a literal `temperature=`/`max_tokens=` at every guarded_llm_create site (so V2 keeps `token_limit_kwargs`/`sampling_kwargs`; a literal `response_format=` is allowed by M1), and `test_resolved_models_unchanged` pins vision -> gpt-4o-mini. test_cost_meter_s74.py:1140/:1469 pin ONE dispatch through guarded_llm_create on the vision model (from their docstrings). The flag-OFF OUTPUT shape is pinned by tests/test_camera_vision.py::TestIdentifyProductsMocked (brand default 'Unknown', name default 'Unknown Product', confidence default 'medium', size_or_count carried, cost > 0, non-JSON -> {products: [], error 'Failed to parse...', raw_response}); these are the 3 rows in tests/.pre_impl_failures.txt:81-83 that fail at base because MagicMock usage makes `cached_tokens > 0` raise TypeError in _log_cache_telemetry. Therefore B3 must ADD the flag-OFF byte pin itself (sha256 of the rendered text part and of the kwargs minus messages, measured at base) and record the V2 render as its own flag-ON digest. IMPORTANT constraint on where digests live: the W4-11 recorder's main() rewrites ALL keys, and the fixture deliberately holds PRE-fence digests for FENCE_KEYS (targeted_system, targeted_user, url_extract_user, image_tier3_user) which test_prompt_truth.py::test_render_digests_match_base_except_the_fence asserts must DIFFER from the live render; running the recorder would overwrite them and redden that test. So the W4-11 fixture is not regenerated by B3 at all.

answers.ruling_text: RULING B4-PROMPT-PINS (binding for B4). (1) `URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT` (app/services/url_extraction_service.py:354-383) is not edited. B4 adds `URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT_V2` (the same text plus the `is_product_page` JSON field and its rule) and `extract_with_ai` picks the constant per call: `URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT_V2 if url_mode_v2_enabled() else URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT`; the render keeps the exact shape SEARCH_RESULTS_GUARD + '\n\n' + prompt.format(url=neutralize_prompt_tags(url), page_block=_wrap_search_context(...)), the `URL: {url}` line before `{page_block}`, one region, and the identical 9-key category enumeration, so test_prompt_fence F11/F13 and test_url_compare_category pass on both constants. (2) Flag OFF the kwargs stay exactly {model gpt-4o-mini, max_tokens 800, temperature 0.1, store False} (M3 pin and the W4-11 `url_extract_kwargs` equality); any flag-ON kwargs addition (response_format for the is_product_page object) is inside the `url_mode_v2_enabled()` branch only, and `ENABLE_URL_MODE_V2` is added to the autouse clear-list of tests/test_model_config_enforced.py (:103-106), to tests/w4_11_prompt_digest_recorder.py FLAGS (:41-45) and tests/test_prompt_fence._W411_FLAGS (:50-56) so a local export can never leak into those renders, and to the U13 CLEAN_ENV (:72-83) because the URL routes now read it per call. (3) The W4-11 fixture is NOT regenerated and `python -m tests.w4_11_prompt_digest_recorder` is NOT run (its main() would overwrite the four pre-fence FENCE_KEYS and redden test_prompt_truth.py::test_render_digests_match_base_except_the_fence). Because the flag-OFF URL-extract render has no byte-equality digest today, B4 adds one in its own module: PIN `URL_EXTRACT_SHA_OFF` = sha256 of the rendered user message for the recorder's BENIGN_HTML/benign URL inputs with the flag deleted, measured at base through the REAL extract_with_ai with the recorder's fake_client; RED/then-PIN `URL_EXTRACT_SHA_V2` with the flag set; plus a PIN `sha256(URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT) == <base literal>` on the constant itself. (4) test_url_compare_category.py::test_extraction_prompt_uses_canonical_categories is parametrised over both constants (no stale tokens, five canonical tokens) in the same PR. answers.ruling_text: RULING B8-LANG (binding for B8). (1) Schema: apply ruling T23-RERECORD verbatim (three `lang` declarations copied from text_routes.py:377/:784; one fixture re-record at the unit HEAD; BASE_SHA_PREFIX and the two docstrings updated; the fixture diff limited to the four listed paths; the PR body sentence). (2) Forwarding: image_routes.py:450 becomes `service.compare_from_text(query, region=region, vision_products=products, nocache=nocache, **({"output_lang": _ol} if (_ol := normalize_output_lang(lang)) else {}))`; `compare_from_urls` (url_extraction_service.py:575) gains a keyword-only `output_lang: Optional[str] = None` and url_routes.py's helper (:119-123) and both handlers pass it the same conditional way; a request without `lang` (every shipped phone, build 3 included) produces a call with NO output_lang kwarg (the W4-14a 28b pattern), so the UR11 T17 records and every stubbed call-arg pin stay byte-identical. (3) RED/PIN rows mirror tests/test_arabic_verdict_output_w414.py for the two new routes: 27-style (GET /url/compare and POST /image/identify declare a bounded lang; 9 chars -> 422), 26b-style (POST /url/compare body lang of 9 chars -> 422), 28-style ('ar'/'AR'/' ar-BH ' -> output_lang='ar' reaches the stubbed service), 28b-style (absent/'fr'/'' -> no kwarg), 35-style (flag ON + no lang = today's bytes). Every node sets or deletes ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT and sends a fixed X-Request-ID. (4) Language is never inferred from the stored profile or Accept-Language (R-A10); the server-side Arabic templates, `output_language_ok`, the Arabic-aware guards and the token cap are behind ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT AND output_lang == 'ar' only; with the flag OFF or lang absent the text, camera and URL bodies are byte-identical (prove with the UR11 T17 records, the W4-13 ledger fixture, the S75 identity digests run base -> head -> base). (5) The client half (`lang` on image and URL requests) merges under C2 and is inert until the flag flips; no OTA before approval (UB-R4). (6) The PR body maps MYEZ-016 -> node ids -> ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT -> activation precondition 'after W4-14b/c land and the T23 re-record is merged'.
